name: OC Dream Center
notes: Listed as an OC Food Bank/CAPOC distribution partner (capoc.org/distribution-partners), but no specific recurring day/time published on CAPOC, org site, or directories. Search results for 'OC Dream Center' schedule returned the unrelated OKC Dream Center (Oklahoma). No credible OC schedule found.

name: OCC Recovery Kitchen
notes: Orange Coast College food-recovery program (2701 Fairview, Costa Mesa) that redistributes surplus meals to shelters/families; not a walk-up public pantry with a set recurring day/time. No published distribution schedule found.

name: Estrella Family Foundation
notes: OC Food Bank/CAPOC partner. Website (estrellafamilyfoundation.org), Facebook, and Instagram show no recurring food-distribution day/time. Not found on Second Harvest (feedoc) partner list. No specific schedule sourced.

name: Grace Community Services
notes: 1645 W Valencia Dr, Fullerton (aka Grace Ministries International). CAPOC partner but no specific recurring day/time published. Search hits for 'Grace Community Food Pantry' hours were other-state locations, not this Fullerton site. No credible schedule found.

name: Heaven Scent Church and Ministries
notes: CAPOC distribution partner (3806 W Commonwealth Ave, Fullerton). No org website/Facebook schedule and no directory listing with a specific recurring day/time. Not found.

name: New Wine Church
notes: 1425 S Brookhurst, Fullerton. Website/directory mention weekly non-perishable groceries and a daily free bread cart (out by ~6 AM), and donation drop-off hours 9 AM-1 PM / 5:30-7:30 PM any day, but these are not a defined public distribution day+time. iCarol pantry listing page is not yet published. No specific recurring distribution schedule confirmed.

name: Searchlight Ministries
notes: CAPOC partner (2311 E Chapman Ave, Fullerton). Operates a preschool; no published food-pantry day/time on website, Facebook, or directories. Not found.

name: True Unity Baptist Church
notes: 1535 Deerpark Dr, Fullerton. CAPOC partner; church describes feeding/clothing the homeless for 30+ years but no specific recurring distribution day/time published on website or Facebook. Not found.

name: Asociacion Evangelistica Impacto de Poder
notes: 11832 Euclid St, Garden Grove. Listed as OC Food Bank/CAPOC distribution partner (501c3 religious org) but no specific recurring distribution day/time found on any credible source.

name: Assembly of God Bethlehem Ministry Inc
notes: 9851 Bixby Ave, Garden Grove (Brazilian AG congregation). Listed as OC Food Bank/CAPOC pantry partner but no specific recurring distribution day/time published on church listings or directories. Not found.
